paragraphs.text: Barktooth Warbeard was an old soldier serving as a Marshal of the kentsu of Madara .

Barktooth Warbeard was as large as Kasimir , a veritable giant , but far less muscular. He was heavy and solid, strong enough to break a Mountain Yeti in two, though his days of charging forward to meet the enemy head-on were a memory. He wore a red breastplate with the kentsu falcon stenciled across the front, his iron-gray hair and beard framing his face, and a wide still broadsword riding his hip. Warbeard was loved by his troops, having survived dozens of imperial campaigns and having a reputation for minimizing his casualties even as he achieved the emperor's objectives.
According to legend, Barktooth once fought a Rock Hydra .

During the Madara-Edemi War , Barktooth Warbeard led the occupation force on Kusho , but was killed and replaced by the shapeshifter Halfdane , who had been ordered by his master Ramses Overdark to infiltrate the kentsu.
